title: Relative spectrum of an algebra sheaf on a fibred groupoid
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with universes as in [def-weil-size-convention], and let $p:\mathcal X\to\mathit{Sch}/S$ be a category fibred in groupoids, with based functors as in [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. Let $\mathcal A$ be a sheaf of commutative $\mathcal O_{\mathcal X}$-algebras [def-sfb-stack-quasi-coherent-algebra]. For an object $x$ of $\mathcal X$, let $\pi_x:\mathcal X/x\to\mathcal X$ be the forgetful functor. An algebra point of $\mathcal A$ over $x$ is a natural ring-sheaf map $a:\pi_x^*\mathcal A\to\pi_x^*\mathcal O_{\mathcal X}$ satisfying $a\circ\pi_x^*\eta=\mathrm{id}$, where $\eta:\mathcal O_{\mathcal X}\to\mathcal A$ is the structure map and $\pi_x^*$ here means precomposition on the whole slice. For $f:y\to x$, restriction is precomposition with the functor $\mathcal X/y\to\mathcal X/x$ sending $(z\to y)$ to $(z\to y\to x)$. This defines a set-valued presheaf $P_{\mathcal A}$ on $\mathcal X$. Define $\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_{\mathcal X}\mathcal A$ to be the category of pairs $(x,a)$, with an arrow $(y,b)\to(x,a)$ an arrow $f:y\to x$ such that $b=P_{\mathcal A}(f)(a)$. Equivalently it is the opposite of the category of elements of $P_{\mathcal A}$. The forgetful functor sends $(x,a)$ to $x$ and an arrow to $f$; composed with $p$ it makes the relative spectrum a category over $\mathit{Sch}/S$. Its canonical based projection to $\mathcal X$ is that same forgetful functor. This defines the functor-of-algebra-points relative spectrum without assuming quasi-coherence, algebraicity or finiteness; no representability or algebraicity is asserted here.
